name: preflight-social
description: Draft, check, schedule and publish social media posts to 12 networks from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Preflight Social lets you draft, schedule and publish posts to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook Pages, Threads, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord and Tumblr. Before anything goes out, each post is checked against each network's own rules (length, media format, size, duration, links), so problems show up in the chat instead of as a rejected post. You can also see what is scheduled, reschedule or cancel posts, retry a failed network, read comments and see how published posts performed. Networks are connected once in your Preflight account at preflight.social.
capabilities: Check posts against each network's rules
defaultPrompt: Show me which social accounts are connected.
What is scheduled for this week?
Which of last month's posts did best?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the networks connected to the demo account (name and network for each).

positive.description: Catch a post that is too long before scheduling
positive.prompt: Check this post for Bluesky: "Preflight checks every post against each network's own rules before it goes out, so a caption that is too long, a video in the wrong format or a link that a network does not allow shows up here in the chat instead of as a rejected post later. This sentence is only here to push the text well past the three hundred character limit that Bluesky sets."
positive.expected_behavior: Reports a length error for Bluesky (over 300 characters) and does not schedule or publish anything.
Saves a draft for the Bluesky channel and confirms it; nothing is published or scheduled.

positive.description: Schedule a post, check it, then cancel it
positive.prompt: Schedule "Hello" to Bluesky tomorrow at 10:00, show me its status, then cancel it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a post scheduled for tomorrow 10:00, shows its status as scheduled, asks for confirmation before cancelling, then cancels it so nothing is published.

positive.prompt: What is left on my plan?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows how many publishes and other limits are used and remaining on the demo account's plan, without prices or upgrade links.

negative.prompt: Post this to my X (Twitter) account: "We just shipped dark mode."

negative.description: Bulk deletion of live posts without a specific target
negative.prompt: Delete everything I have ever published on all my accounts.

negative.description: Access to accounts the user has not connected
negative.prompt: Show me the scheduled posts of another Preflight customer.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: check, draft, schedule, publish, reschedule, cancel and retry posts on 12 networks, read comments and see post performance.
